Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

PersonalLabel.description: A member's personal label for one room, as their key holder keeps it: at least one detail (`minProperties` counts `updatedAt`), and when it last changed. A key holder that holds no detail for the room holds no label, and returns none — there is no empty label.

updatedAt.description: When the label last changed, as the key holder recorded it. A request that changed nothing does not move it.

PersonalLabel.title: PersonalLabel

PersonalLabelDescription.description: What the room is to the member, in a sentence or a short paragraph. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are not.
PersonalLabelDescription.title: PersonalLabelDescription

PersonalLabelName.description: The member's own name for the room, on one line: no control characters, line breaks included. Shown before every name a third party gave the room, because it is the only one nobody else wrote.
PersonalLabelName.title: PersonalLabelName

PersonalLabelNotes.description: Longer free-form notes the member keeps about the room: who introduced them, what to look for in it, what they agreed there. Line breaks and tabs are allowed; other control characters are not.
PersonalLabelNotes.title: PersonalLabelNotes

PersonalLabelTag.description: A word or short phrase the member files the room under, in any script, so their own surfaces can group and filter their rooms. Compared exactly, as a string: a key holder does not case-fold or normalise it.
PersonalLabelTag.title: PersonalLabelTag

PersonalLabelTags.description: The member's tags for the room, one to sixteen, as a set: order carries no meaning. A room with no tags has no `tags` member, never an empty list, so there is one way to say "none".
PersonalLabelTags.title: PersonalLabelTags

Response.description: Success response to rooms/keys/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/rooms/keys/list/0.2#response. The rooms this key holder can open, one entry per room and member, for the members the caller may act as. This is key custody, not membership: a room whose group state was never delivered is absent here and the member may still hold a perfectly good VMC for it.

rooms.description: One entry per room and member, in no guaranteed order. A room held as two members the caller may act as appears twice, once per member.

earliestReadableEpoch.description: The earliest epoch this key holder can derive a key for, for this member, walking the epoch key chain it holds. Equal to `epoch` means it reads only from where it joined; `1` means the room's whole retained history. Anything between is a chain that has been delivered in part, or one deliberately severed below that point.

epoch.description: The epoch this key holder is at for this member. Behind the room's own epoch means a commit has not been delivered, and records sealed since will not open.

member.description: The member this entry's group state is held for: the DID the room admitted. What a client names as `member` to rooms/keys/label, and as `issuer` to rooms/keys/act, to act on this entry rather than on the same room held as another member.

personal.description: The member's own label for the room (rooms/keys/label). Present only when the request set `includePersonal: true` and the member has one. Private to the member: a caller MUST NOT pass it to the room's host, its owner, a community or a website the member has not chosen to show it to.

Response.title: Rooms Keys List — response payload

schema.description: List the rooms the key holder can open for members the caller may act as. `includePersonal` asks for each entry's personal label as well; absent, none is returned. Carries no filter: the recipient answers for the members its caller acts as, and there is nothing to ask it about. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

includePersonal.description: `true` asks for each entry's personal label (rooms/keys/label) in `personal`. Absent or `false`: no entry carries one. A request option, not a filter — it changes which members of an entry are returned, never which entries — and off by default so that a caller that has no use for the member's own names, or will pass the list on, never receives them.

schema.title: Rooms Keys List — payload
